title: Docunight
intro: SIGS and the Jordan Center presented monthly Iranian documentary screenings in 2017-2018. They were free and open to the public, with English subtitles.

sections.title: A shared campus program
paragraphs: The Jordan Center's 2017-2018 annual report lists the Irvine Docunight series as a joint program with SIGS. The films were about Iran or made by Iranian filmmakers.
This was a past series. For upcoming screenings and gatherings, see Events.

sections.title: More film and poetry events
paragraphs: The 2016 Tales invitation included a screening and a Q&A with screenwriter Farid Mostafavi. In 2019, SIGS held Persian Poetry Night at Palo Verde.
We are still missing individual Docunight dates and film titles. If you remember a screening, please help us fill in the details.

title: A welcome to campus
intro: SIGS has welcomed new students at orientation, barbecues and dinners. These gatherings give newcomers a chance to meet other students and ask about life at UCI.

sections.title: Welcoming new students
paragraphs: SIGS joined International Graduate Students Orientation in 2012 and invited new Iranian students to meet the team at the Student Center. In 2017, the welcome invitation was for a barbecue at Verano Place.
In September 2023, SIGS welcomed new students to Palo Verde for information, Q&A and dinner. Iranian Students of California supported the gathering through its NewComers program.
The 2018 invitation welcomed new and returning UCI students and alumni to a barbecue and orientation at Verano Place Commons.

sections.title: New to UCI?
paragraphs: Our newcomer guide links to UCI offices for arrival, housing, transportation and student support. Those offices have the current requirements and service details.
You can say hello before your first event. Tell us you are new to campus and ask what you need to know. Before attending, check the event page for registration and who can join.

title: Time together
intro: Some SIGS evenings are for a bonfire, a game of volleyball or dinner with friends.
periodLabel: Barbecues, games and beach gatherings across the archive

sections.title: An evening at the beach
paragraphs: SIGS gathered around a bonfire at Corona del Mar on October 7, 2017. The Huntington Beach outing in July 2018 included a two-player volleyball tournament.
You can find later bonfire invitations in the event archive.
In August 2019, SIGS invited the community to another beach volleyball tournament at Corona del Mar, with two-player teams and a gift card for the winners.
In October 2023, we met for a bonfire at Corona del Mar, then celebrated Halloween at Palo Verde.

sections.title: Games and a shared meal
paragraphs: Game Night 11 invited guests to Palo Verde in August 2017 for a potluck and card and board games. Later invitations included online Mafia and more game nights at the clubhouse.
Iftar brought friends to Palo Verde in 2017. Other invitations included a 2012 barbecue, Iftar in 2015, 2018 and 2019, and a Persian breakfast in March 2019.
In May 2019, SIGS invited students to go bowling at Bowlmor Lanes. The June potluck invitation was for lunch at Verano Place Commons, with burgers, hot dogs and dishes brought by guests.

sections.title: A conversation about health
paragraphs: In September 2020, SIGS and Seeb Magazine invited the community to a Persian-language Zoom talk on nutrition and wellness with Dr. Zahra Azadbadi.

sections.title: World Cup watch parties
paragraphs: On June 15, 2018, the Iranian student community watched Iran play Morocco at Palo Verde Clubhouse. A group photo and celebration video mark Iran's 1-0 win.
The June 26, 2026 watch party was for Iran vs. Egypt at Campus Village Community Center's Theater Room, with free admission.

title: Nowruz and Yalda
intro: Our Nowruz and Yalda celebrations have included Hafez readings, live music and dinner. The photos and invitations below go back to 2012.

sections.title: Poetry, music and a shared table
paragraphs: The earliest Nowruz invitation here is from March 2012. Later celebrations included Hafez readings, ensemble music and dinner, often with other student organizations.
Kamyar performed at Yalda in 2018, and Sandy and his band joined the 2019 celebration. Both years have photo albums to browse.

sections.title: Different years, different formats
paragraphs: The March 2020 Nowruz celebration was cancelled. A virtual Yalda was advertised that December, followed by the Milad Derakhshani online Nowruz concert announcement in March 2021.

In March 2023, we celebrated Nowruz with a whale-watching cruise from Balboa Pavilion. On December 21, 2025, Yalda brought us to Verano Community Center for Persian food and an evening together, the first event hosted by the then-new SIGS board. Both gatherings have photo albums to browse.

For Nowruz 2022, SIGS and Northeastern University's Global Learner Support announced a program with Massoume Price on Nowruz history, symbolism and celebrations around the world, alongside traditional music from UCI.

sections.title: Music and cultural conversation
paragraphs: The 2013 archive also includes SIGS's invitation to a lecture with Mohammad Reza Shajarian and the Pournazeri brothers on new instruments in Persian classical music, co-sponsored by the Samuel Jordan Center.

title: Professional connections
intro: SIGS has worked with alumni groups and community organizations on career panels, technology events and networking. The programs below go back to 2018.

sections.title: The Iranian American Innovation Forum
paragraphs: The Iranian American Innovation Forum took place at the UCI Student Center on September 15, 2018. SIGS co-sponsored it with the Iranian Americans' Contributions Project (IACP) and Sharif University of Technology Association (SUTA).
The program covered technology, business and social innovation. The Jordan Center's annual report lists the forum among its campus collaborations.

sections.title: Career panels and technology conversations
paragraphs: The Iranian American Alumni Chapter and SIGS advertised a June 2019 career panel at Newkirk Alumni Center, with discussion of the automotive industry, law and biotechnology.
In May 2023, SIGS and Iranian Students of California invited the community to Persian Tech Network at Plug and Play HQ and online.

A January 2019 invitation welcomed students and alumni to Newkirk Alumni Center for networking. That August, SIGS invited the community to ask immigration attorney Gazal N. Mehrani about the travel ban and HR-1044.

sections.title: Rising Leaders, 2025
paragraphs: IAW Foundation's Orange County Rising Leaders announced a February 2025 event in partnership with SIGS. The invitation described professional circles in fields including law, technology, business, engineering and media.
The invitation described introductions and icebreakers within each circle, followed by networking bingo across groups.

sections.title: Have a topic to share?
paragraphs: Tell us what you would like to discuss, who it is for and how you would like to take part.

title: Poetry and film
intro: SIGS has hosted Persian Poetry Night and invited the community to Rumi classes and screenings with filmmaker Q&As.

sections.title: Monthly Rumi and Shams sessions
paragraphs: In 2013, SIGS invited the public to free monthly sessions on Rumi's Masnavi and the ghazals of Shams with Dr. Khazali. Five dated invitations survive, for meetings at Palo Verde and the Student Center.
The June meeting was advertised as the third session in the series.

sections.title: Films and the people behind them
paragraphs: A 2013 Saadat Abad screening invitation included a Q&A with Maziar Miri. A 2014 Hush! Girls Don't Scream invitation named Pouran Derakhshandeh, the film's director and producer.

The 2016 Tales invitation paired the film with a screenwriter Q&A. SIGS and the Visual Studies PhD Program co-sponsored the Jordan Center event. A later 2024 movie-night invitation offered another evening of films and music.

SIGS took part in Pol Media's Orange County film weekend in July 2019. The following year, SIGS appeared among the California student groups inviting viewers to Secrets of the Surface, followed by a panel with Maryam Mirzakhani's friends and collaborators.

sections.title: An evening for Persian poetry
paragraphs: SIGS held Persian Poetry Night at Palo Verde on February 23, 2019. The free invitation listed 8 to 11 PM and welcomed anyone who wanted to read poetry or perform music.
For documentary films, see the Docunight series that SIGS and the Jordan Center presented in 2017-2018.
